run_form_composer_task_with_worker_opini: run a mephisto form composer task with worker opinion enabled using the local inhouse operator
build_form_composer_simple_react_app: build a simple form composer react app with optional force rebuild and post install script
launch_mephisto_task_run: launch a mephisto task run using the operator with the provided configuration
wait_for_runs_then_shutdown: wait for all mephisto task runs to complete then shutdown the operator with periodic logging
set_react_app_worker_opinion_env: set the REACT_APP__WITH_WORKER_OPINION environment variable to enable worker opinion features
